clue.text: Labour's dispute about tip from Kinnock

indicators.note: about signals turning the word for the quarrel round

parts.note: a row is a quarrel or dispute

indicators.note: the tip of a name is its opening letter, so take the start of Kinnock

explanation.surface: A Labour Party quarrel over a hint from its former leader Neil Kinnock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns ROW into WOR. Neil Kinnock was a leader of the UK Labour Party, which makes 'Labour' look like the party; it is plain toil.
explanation.definitionFit: Labour as a noun is toil or effort, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Head off agents whose 1 is to 8

indicators.note: taking the head off a word drops its first letter

parts.note: factors are agents who buy or sell on behalf of others

explanation.surface: An instruction to intercept some agents, with the theme's cross-references tacked on.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 is WORK and 8 is PLAY, the puzzle's theme: people whose work is to play.
explanation.definitionFit: Performers make their living by appearing in plays, so playing is their job.

clue.text: Way to record music, two dances including cover of tango

indicators.note: including puts the cover of the next word between the two dances

parts.note: a reel is a lively Scottish dance, and two of them are wanted
a reel is a lively Scottish dance, and two of them are wanted

indicators.note: the cover of a word is its outside letters, first and last

explanation.surface: A way of recording dance music, here two dances with a tango wrapped in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cover of' gives TO, the outer letters of tango, placed between the two REELs.
explanation.definitionFit: Open-spool magnetic tape recording, used in studios before cassettes, is a method of capturing music.

clue.text: Awkward moment? Extremely sorry about it

indicators.note: about puts the extreme letters of sorry around the word for a moment
the extremes of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: a tick is an instant, as in 'just a tick'

explanation.surface: An embarrassing moment, and someone apologising profusely for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely' gives S and Y from sorry, which go round TICK.
explanation.definitionFit: A tricky or uncomfortable situation is described as sticky, as in a sticky wicket.

clue.text: Wide cravat conceals trendy lining

parts.note: W is the cricket abbreviation for a wide

indicators.note: conceals puts the word for trendy inside the cravat

parts.note: an ascot is a broad neck scarf or cravat
in means fashionable or trendy

explanation.surface: A broad cravat hiding a fashionable lining, like a stylish garment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lining' suggests a garment's inner fabric, but here it is panelling on a wall; 'conceals' puts IN within the cravat.
explanation.definitionFit: Wooden panelling lining the lower part of a room's walls is called by this name.

clue.text: Begin the games, running round

indicators.note: round puts the word for running around the school games

parts.note: a machine that is running is on
PE, physical education, is school games

explanation.surface: An instruction to start the games, with athletes running round a track.
explanation.walkthrough: PE is physical education, the British school subject often called games.
explanation.definitionFit: To open something is to start or commence it.

clue.text: Old lady is French, large and round, showing way to 8 a 1

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother, one's old lady
est is French for is
OS stands for outsize, a clothing size for large
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A rotund old Frenchwoman, cast as a guide to performing a piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is PLAY and 1 is WORK: a direction on how to play a musical work.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian tempo marking tells musicians to perform majestically and stately.

clue.text: 1 that's not 1?

parts.note: a dramatic work for the stage, which is also the opposite of toil

explanation.walkthrough: 1 is WORK: a theatrical work, and also what work is not, leisure.
explanation.definitionFit: A drama is a written work, yet recreation is the opposite of labour.

clue.text: Bust into alternative artist's group that'll 8 1s

indicators.note: into puts the bust between the alternative and the artist

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
the bust is the chest

explanation.surface: A sculpted bust put into an artist's other group, as if exhibiting.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is PLAY and 1 is WORK: a body that will play works.
explanation.definitionFit: A symphonic ensemble of musicians performs musical compositions together.

clue.text: Toll to import rare gem

indicators.note: import means bring in, so the word for toll takes in the letter for rare

parts.note: a bell's toll is its peal

explanation.surface: A customs charge levied on bringing in a rare jewel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Toll' looks like a tax but is a bell's ring.
explanation.definitionFit: A lustrous jewel formed inside an oyster is a classic precious stone.

clue.text: A little molehill on knobbly round mound

indicators.note: round turns the selected letters back to front
a little of the words means just a few of their letters are taken

explanation.surface: A small molehill sitting on a lumpy round heap of earth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A little' takes LLONK from 'molehill on knobbly'; 'round' turns it back.
explanation.definitionFit: A small rounded hill or hillock is a synonym for a mound.

clue.text: Heartlessly tricking society through PM's novel …

indicators.note: heartlessly removes the middle letter of the word for tricking

parts.note: conning is tricking
by means through, as in by means of

explanation.surface: A prime minister's novel achieved by cruelly fooling high society.
explanation.walkthrough: The PM is Benjamin Disraeli, a 19th-century British prime minister and novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Disraeli wrote this 1844 political novel about a young aristocrat.

clue.text: … the fellow's party chronicles

parts.note: his means belonging to the fellow
the Tory party is the UK Conservatives

explanation.surface: Continuing the novel: a man's political party and its records.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipses link this to Disraeli in 12, a Tory leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Chronicles are records of past events, as a written account of times gone by.

clue.text: River dweller in river

parts.note: hip means fashionable, as does in
the Po is a river in Italy

explanation.surface: Something living in a river, found in a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link but means trendy.
explanation.definitionFit: The large African mammal spends its days submerged in rivers.

clue.text: Abandoned 8ers not at 1

parts.note: 8 is play, so players are the cast of a show
1 is work, and someone not at work is off

explanation.surface: Players left stranded while not at their job.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is PLAY and 1 is WORK, the theme answers.
explanation.definitionFit: Something discarded or thrown away by its owner has been rejected.

clue.text: Step on ship — it'll make 8 1

parts.note: a stage is a step in a process
a craft is a boat or ship

explanation.surface: Stepping onto a ship as the skill that makes something succeed.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is PLAY and 1 is WORK: what makes a play work.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatrical skill in production and acting is what makes a drama succeed.

clue.text: Fellow inadequate as a lover

parts.note: lame means weak or inadequate, as a lame excuse

explanation.surface: A man who falls short as a romantic partner.
explanation.definitionFit: An old sweetheart is called an old flame, so the word means a romantic partner.

clue.text: Joe Biden, say, turned on English in vexation

indicators.note: turned means the word for the vice president is read backwards

parts.note: veep is US slang for vice president, as Biden once was

explanation.surface: Joe Biden rounding on the English in irritation.
explanation.walkthrough: Biden was US vice president under Obama, hence the veep.
explanation.definitionFit: A pet hate or source of annoyance is an irritation.

clue.text: Land with patio, ie ground around front of house

indicators.note: around puts the shuffled letters about the front of the house
ground means crushed, so the letters are broken up and rearranged
the front of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A property with a patio, i.e. grounds around the house front.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground' reads as the land round a house but signals the anagram, making ETIOPIA, which goes 'around' H.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a country in the Horn of Africa, a nation or land.

clue.text: Extremely gruesome story keeps providing solution to all 1 and no 8

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its first and last letters
keeps means holds, so the story holds the word for providing

parts.note: a tale is a story
if means providing, as in providing that

explanation.surface: A grisly tale offering an answer to a dull existence.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 is WORK and 8 is PLAY: the proverb 'all work and no play makes Jack a dull boy'.
explanation.definitionFit: This exasperated retort tells someone to stop slaving and find some fun.

clue.text: 21 turning up in spirit, with good hygienic habits

indicators.note: in puts the turned word inside the spirit

parts.note: gin is a spirit

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up reads the word from bottom to top

parts.note: 21 is Othello, the Moor of Venice

explanation.surface: Othello showing up drunk, yet well turned out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' gives ROOM from MOOR; G for good goes on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Personal care of hair and appearance is tidy self-presentation.

clue.text: A woman, undressed after symbolic resistance, gets bouquet

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance

indicators.note: undressed strips off the outer letters of the word

explanation.surface: A woman stripping after a symbolic act of resistance, then receiving flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'undressed' gives OMA from woman, which comes after R.
explanation.definitionFit: The bouquet of a wine is its pleasant smell or fragrance.

clue.text: Back to location of damned old 8 (that's a 1)

indicators.note: back means the little word is read the other way round

parts.note: hell is where the damned go

explanation.surface: A return to the abode of damned souls, an old tragedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is PLAY and 1 is WORK: Shakespeare's tragedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's tragedy of the Moor of Venice is a drama and a literary work.

clue.text: Spin and dodge 1 you can 8

parts.note: PR, public relations, is spin
elude means dodge or evade

explanation.surface: Spin and evasion, a politician's habits.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 is WORK and 8 is PLAY: a piece you can perform.
explanation.definitionFit: An introductory musical composition, as by Chopin, is a work musicians perform.

clue.text: Princess interrupts high kick in the buff

indicators.note: interrupts means breaks into the kick

parts.note: a punt is a high kick in rugby or American football
Di is Princess Diana

explanation.surface: A princess cutting short a naked high-kicking dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the buff' reads as naked, but buff is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A buff is an enthusiast or expert, and the word means an authority.

clue.text: Where Ban Ki-moon gets water needing treatment?

parts.note: Ban Ki-moon was Secretary-General of the UN
a well is where water is drawn

explanation.surface: A former UN leader drawing water needing purification.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treatment' suggests water purification, but it means medical care.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone ill requires medical care, so the word means sick.

clue.text: Vagrant tramp's son, his 1 is to 8

indicators.note: vagrant means wandering, so the letters stray into a new order

explanation.surface: A homeless wanderer's son whose job is to play.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 is WORK and 8 is PLAY: an athlete paid to play.
explanation.definitionFit: A professional athlete makes a living from playing games.

clue.text: Small, standard box

parts.note: par is the standard or norm

explanation.surface: A small regular-sized container.
explanation.definitionFit: To spar is to practise boxing.

clue.text: Not US close to Soviet border

indicators.note: the close of a word is its final letter

parts.note: a hem is the border of a garment

explanation.surface: Not American territory, near the Soviet frontier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'US' looks like the United States but is the pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: The other side, as opposed to our group, as in 'us and them'.

clue.text: Bank, with hesitation, produces one of eight?

parts.note: a bank is a row, as a bank of switches
er is a hesitation sound

explanation.surface: A bank teller hesitating while producing figures.
explanation.walkthrough: An eight is a rowing crew; the question mark flags the definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: A rowing eight has eight oarsmen, each of whom pulls an oar.

clue.text: Touching way you could thus link 1 and 8

parts.note: re means concerning or touching on
St, street, is a way

explanation.surface: A tender route connecting two ideas.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 is WORK and 8 is PLAY: the phrase 'work, rest and play'.
explanation.definitionFit: The slogan 'work, rest and play' puts this word between the two themed terms.

clue.text: See 19
Digital tools capture data

parts.note: to nail is to catch or capture
files hold data

explanation.surface: Computer tools that capture data.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Digital' suggests computers but refers to fingers.
explanation.definitionFit: Emery boards and metal rasps for shaping fingernails are implements for digits.
